assets.postProcess: Resize to exactly 4096x2048 (2:1) and blend the left/right edges so the panorama wraps. The output is LDR; the game boosts the sun region to fake HDR range.
assets.prompt: 360 degree equirectangular panorama, full spherical HDRI sky map, 2:1 projection, horizon exactly on the vertical centre line, seamless left and right edges. Golden hour over a flat dusty Middle-Eastern city: low warm sun about 12 degrees above the horizon, soft orange haze near the horizon fading to pale blue zenith, thin high cirrus clouds, distant low-rise sand-coloured rooftops and minarets as a thin silhouette band only at the horizon, lower half is plain flat sandy ground. No foreground objects, no people, no lens flare, no text, photorealistic, evenly exposed.

assets.postProcess: Key out the sky to alpha (keep buildings only) and make the left/right edges tile.
